title: US 10-Year Yield Rises to Highest Since '07, Trump Says AI Fears a 'Hoax'
description:
Global bonds sell off with the US 10-year Treasury yield rising to levels last seen 19 years ago. President Trump dismisses AI dangers. Priya Misra of JPMorgan Asset Management joins "Bloomberg Brief" and says we may be nearing the end of the rate move and discusses market catalysts.
